available_water_capacity.description: Available water expressed as an equivalent depth per soil depth.

brooks_corey_alpha.description: Inverse pressure-scale parameter of a Brooks-Corey retention model.

dry_bulk_density.description: Dry bulk density, including density adjusted for gravel or compaction.

field_texture_class_code.description: Numeric code assigned to a source-defined field-texture class.

gravel_volume_fraction.description: Volumetric fraction of gravel in bulk soil.

gravimetric_water_content.description: Gravimetric soil water content or a difference between such contents.

log_saturated_hydraulic_conductivity.description: Reported logarithm of saturated hydraulic conductivity.

log_saturation_potential.description: Reported logarithm of saturation matric potential.

matric_potential.description: Soil matric potential, tension, suction, or pressure head.

organic_carbon_content.description: Organic carbon content expressed relative to dry soil mass.

organic_matter_content.description: Organic matter content expressed relative to dry soil mass under the declared analytical method.

particle_mass_fraction.description: Mass fraction of soil particles within an explicitly defined particle-size interval.

retention_coefficient_a.description: Pressure-dimensional coefficient of an empirical retention relation.

retention_coefficient_b.description: Dimensionless exponent of an empirical retention relation.

saturated_hydraulic_conductivity.description: Saturated hydraulic conductivity, including pore-domain components.

soil_hydraulic_slope_parameter.description: Dimensionless slope parameter of a soil hydraulic model.

soil_structure_class_code.description: Numeric code assigned to a source-defined soil-structure class.

van_genuchten_alpha.description: Inverse pressure-scale parameter of a van Genuchten retention model.

van_genuchten_m.description: Dimensionless van Genuchten retention-curve shape parameter.

van_genuchten_n.description: Dimensionless van Genuchten pore-size distribution parameter.

varallyai_m.description: Shape parameter of the Varallyay retention equation.

varallyai_pf_star.description: Logarithmic suction-scale parameter of the Varallyay retention equation.

volumetric_water_content.description: Volumetric soil water content or an equivalent volumetric fraction.
